brief.headline: Push for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on caps (market says modest room below today's band) and qualify Manjushree or Mold-Tek as second source

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a price in the ₹0.65–0.80/pc range on 28 mm caps
priceAsk.basis: Market asking prices for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps run ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc; the market verdict says 'MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec' — so there is room to move down if we commit bigger volumes or flex the specification

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 30 days after receipt; no reason to shorten

brief.financialLeverage: Empire publishes no financials, so we can't gauge their profit or cash position. Our ₹67.47 L annual spend is real money, but without their revenue figure we don't know if we're 1% or 10% of their business. That means we lean on market benchmarks and on having credible second sources lined up. The plan is to show we've done our homework on alternate suppliers and on what the market will bear, then push for the lower end of the market range.

evidence.point: We spend ₹67.47 L a year with them on rigid plastic packaging
Market asking prices for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps are ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc
Market verdict says there is modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume or looser spec
HDPE resin import unit value is 87.61 ₹/kg
We pay 30 days after receipt today

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; revenue ₹2569.83 Cr, health score B (65/100) — top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (pails, containers, pharma); strong, profitable — a robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed maker of moulded and blow-moulded packaging; broad capability across bottles and caps

risks: Empire's financials aren't public, so we can't tell if a tough price push might hurt their ability to supply us reliably
We have no alternate supplier qualified or priced today — if we lose Empire we scramble; start qualifying Manjushree or Mold-Tek now
The market 'modest headroom' language means the price cut won't be huge; don't expect more than 10–15% down without a big volume jump or spec change
Six market backup leads (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are unqualified — verify each before sending an RFQ
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We've mapped the market for 28 mm caps — asking prices run ₹0.55–1.20 and there's room at ₹0.65–0.80 for volume commitment — and we're qualifying Manjushree and Mold-Tek as second sources, so let's talk about where your price can land.
